title: Contents
slide_intent: Organize the reference by the kind of decision someone needs to make. A reader looking up a specific rule can skip directly to it.
strategic_value: A shared contents page can give editors and designers a common route into strategy, production and voice.
demonstration: A narrow introduction occupies the first column. Numbered sections and entries continue across three columns on white.
practical_value: Find a rule by its section and printed folio, or follow the book from brand foundations through applications.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Set the description under Contents at upper left.

content_islands.name: Topic index
content_islands.spec: Across the rest of the page align section headings, individual topics and folios in compact columns. Use heavier type for the section headings.
